### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[O-Section]: Report all physical examination findings precisely, including any noted abnormalities (e.g., 'abdominal obesity'). Do not generalize 'no abnormalities' if specific atypical findings are mentioned.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[O-Section]: For objective findings, report numerical values precisely. Only include qualitative descriptors (e.g., 'normal', 'high') if explicitly stated by the provider for that *specific* measurement or component. Do not infer normality or absence of abnormalities for components not directly addressed by the provider's examination.
[Global]: Strictly separate subjective patient reports from objective provider findings; do not include patient's subjective descriptions in objective sections.
